name: Bold-Line Field Explainer
description: Simple stick figures in dense, flat-coloured places, with smooth black outlines and explanatory devices built into the scene.
style_bible: A flat-coloured drawn explainer look with simple stick figures and explanatory devices built into the scene. Line: every shape is closed by one smooth black contour of even weight — the same weight on every form at every depth — with confident curves, no sketchiness, no hatching, no double lines. Fill: every surface is one flat colour; no shading, no cel step, no cast shadow, no texture, no highlight. Depth comes only from value steps of a single hue plus a light, soft wash behind the most distant forms. Palette: each frame commits to one dominant family — one hue through four or five values with a neutral earth and a pale tint; or a cool grey field with exactly one warm accent — and stays saturated without neon. Environment: dense and layered, filling the frame edge to edge in three or four value bands, lighter and cooler as they recede, so the near plane is the most saturated. Figures: where a figure appears, it is a white round head, two black dot eyes with small pupils, at most a thin brow or curved mouth when the idea needs it, thin black stick arms and legs with dot or mitten hands, and simple flat clothing blocks. Figures stand low in a level composition, so the density around them does the work. Props: flat outlines with one or two flat fills each. Devices: explanatory marks are objects in the scene, not overlays, drawn as flat shapes that belong to the picture. Lighting: none stated; every value is flat. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed character, place, era, brand or copied composition.
